features: Education-Focused Learning: Designed to support smarter, more interactive study sessions — with a bundled Tab Pen for note-taking, sketching, and calculating, built-in learning apps like Lenovo AI Note, Squid, Nebo, and MyScript Calculator, and Circle to Search for instant answers — making it ideal for students, online classes, self-study, and everyday skill development.

Immersive Visuals with Eye Comfort Built In – Enjoy stunning clarity and vibrant detail on an expansive 11-inch 2.5K display with a sharp 2560 × 1600 resolution. With up to 500 nits brightness and rich 72% NTSC color coverage, every image looks bright and lifelike. The anti-reflection coating ensures comfortable viewing even in bright environments, while TÜV Low Blue Light certification helps reduce eye strain during extended streaming, reading, or work sessions.

Powerful Performance for Everyday Multitasking – Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 octa-core processor, featuring 2 high-performance Cortex-A76 cores clocked at 2.4 GHz and 6 efficient Cortex-A55 cores at 2.0 GHz, this device delivers smooth performance for streaming, gaming, productivity, and everyday multitasking with improved power efficiency.

Fast, Responsive, and Ready for More – Equipped with 8GB LPDDR4x memory for smooth multitasking and responsive performance, along with 256GB UFS 2.2 storage for faster app loading and file transfers. Enjoy ample space for your apps, media, and documents with high-speed storage designed to keep up with your everyday needs.

Immersive Audio and Clear Video Calling – Experience rich, room-filling sound with a powerful quad-speaker setup optimized with Dolby Atmos for enhanced entertainment. Capture everyday moments and stay connected with a 5MP front camera for clear video calls and an 8MP rear camera for quick photos and scans.

Long-Lasting Battery for Non-Stop Entertainment – Stay productive and entertained longer with a large 7040mAh battery designed to power your day with ease. Enjoy up to 12 hours of YouTube streaming on a single charge, while the included 20W charging adapter helps you quickly get back to what you love without long wait times.
